headline: Focus on margin recovery in H2

highlights: (ASTPOL) CMP: ₹1249 Target ₹ 1650 (32%) Target Period: 12 months November 6, 2026 Focus on margin recovery in H2 ; retain Buy About the stock : Astral, established in 1996 by Sandeep Engineer, introduced CPVC piping in India.

Q 2F Y2 7 performance : Astral reported broadly in-line Q2FY27 consolidated revenues at ₹ 1988 crore (up 26% YoY and QoQ) led by both plumbing (revenues up 25% YoY at ₹ 1398 crore) and Paints & adhesives (up 29% YoY at ₹ 590 crore).
Bathware (included in Plumbing) & Paints revenues grew by 27% YoY and 43% YoY at ₹ 42 crore and ₹ 82 crore respectively.
Consolidated EBITDA margins were lower 318 bps YoY (down 155 bps QoQ) at 13.1%.
valuation: (ASTPOL) CMP: ₹1249 Target ₹ 1650 (32%) Target Period: 12 months November 6, 2026 Focus on margin recovery in H2 ; retain Buy About the stock : Astral, established in 1996 by Sandeep Engineer, introduced CPVC piping in India.

Rating and Target Price : • We have lowered our PAT estimates for FY27/FY28 by 15%/6% considering lower EBITDA margins during H1FY27. • We retain Buy with a revised SOTP based price target of ₹ 1650, implied ~55x P/E on FY28E EPS.

For FY27, it targets 290,000 to 300,000 tons in plumbing volume and expects ₹ 1,050 crores EBITDA for the plumbing business, contributing to a consolidated full-year EBITDA estimation of ₹ 1,250 crores.
watch: The paint business is guided to achieve positive EBITDA of 3-4% by year-end FY27 (H1 – negative 2.5%) and 8-10% by FY28. • Demand and Future Outlook: Management indicated that demand during October 2026 was unprecedented across segments.
Investments in securities market are subject to market risks.
